summary.title: URA AI Taxpayer Chatbot - Threat Model
summary.description: Multi-tier MLOps RAG Chatbot architecture for Uganda Revenue Authority. Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, Qdrant vector store, vLLM inference, and Merkle audit ledger.

diagrams.placeholder: Complete architecture context showing trust boundaries and data flows

data.name: Taxpayer
data.description: Ugandan citizen or business querying tax laws, exemptions, and obligations

data.name: Frontend (Next.js 16)
data.description: React-based UI with DOMPurify sanitization, CSP headers, and WebSockets

threats.title: XSS in Markdown Output
threats.description: Adversary injects malicious JavaScript via model response or query reflection
threats.mitigation: DOMPurify and rehype-sanitize filter in Markdown.tsx component

data.name: FastAPI Core Gateway
data.description: BFF API handling auth, InputGuard, OutputGuard, DeBERTa grounding, and RAG retrieval

threats.title: JWT Auth Forgery
threats.description: Attacker attempts to forge staff authorization tokens
threats.mitigation: RS256/HS256 validation with secret rotation and strict claim verification

data.name: Qdrant Vector DB
data.description: Stores dense embeddings for indexed official URA tax documents

threats.title: Vector Index Poisoning
threats.description: Adversary injects fraudulent tax advice documents
threats.mitigation: SHA256 checksum verification and signed corpus ingest pipeline
